completeness.note: All required fields are present and non-empty, including genre, pacing, mood, tags, topics, audience, visual style, and narrative hook. Several values stay broad rather than richly informative.

specificity.note: Almost no episode-level detail: no three-night party scheme, roof, casual-versus-serious conflict, Marshall's paper, or named characters. Tags and topics are generic relationship and friendship fillers.

fidelity.note: Comedy-romance sitcom framing, young-adult audience, and the hook about desperate plans to win a woman match Ted's pursuit of Robin and the heartfelt ending. 'Social experiments' is unsupported, and 'Drama' plus friends' skepticism slightly misstate Marshall's paper stress and Barney's role.

consistency.note: Genre, humorous-sentimental mood, relationship topics, and the pursuit hook agree. 'Social experiments' does not fit the rest of the profile.

recsys_usefulness.note: Comedy, romance, sitcom, and young-adult filters would retrieve the right broad audience, but generic tags would not distinguish this episode from other relationship sitcoms.

summary: The profile is complete and broadly faithful to this romantic sitcom episode, but most discovery fields are generic and a few labels overreach. It would support coarse recommendations more than precise episode matching.
